4.2.3.2 Activation Offset for RunnableEntitys and BswSchedulableEntitys
In order to allow optimizations (smooth cpu load, mapping of RunnableEntitys and BswSchedulableEntitys with different periods in the same task to avoid data sharing, etc.), the RTE has to handle the activation offset information from a task shared reference point only for time trigger RunnableEntitys and BswSchedulableEntitys. The maximum period of a task can be calculated automatically as the greatest common divisor (GCD) of all runnables period and offset.It is assumed that the runnables worst case execution is less than the GCD. In case of the worst case execution is greater than the GCD, the behavior becomes undefined.
